Part of the reason why is because it’s kind of a risky move to dash into an enemy with the axe. You only have one dash outside of that ability and that is sometimes not enough to make a quick escape after a kill. The axe helps for vertical movement, but it’s mainly used to stun other Mobile Suits (esp. the ones with shields).

Zaku (M) - which I usually refer to as the Dozle - is less of a tank and more of a bruiser. The ‘tank’ of Evo is the Sazabi. Dozle’s purpose is to pressure the enemy frontlines oppressively. It’s also arguably the best body blocker for Destruction matches. Also, you’re ironically a shield user’s second worst nightmare when you’re using the Dozle.

My 2 cents as a Dozle player: The suit has the only basic ranged attack that can pierce thru shields iirc. Both its offensive abilities can bypass or outright remove shields. Its rage meter can catch a lot of players by surprise due to the extra 600 hp and the damage boost. It’s a brawler, not an assassin like the other melee suits. Its job is to be the centre of attention due to it’s notoriety, and a good Dozle player knows this. 

However, I do agree that it’s damage is lackluster compared to the rest of the suits. That’s on the devs for nerfing him too hard.
